about.metaDescription: DevBox Tools is a free, privacy-first collection of developer utilities that run entirely in your browser — no server, no tracking of your data.
about.title: About DevBox Tools
about.missionText: DevBox Tools exists to give developers, QA engineers, and backend teams fast, no-friction utilities that respect their privacy. Every tool runs entirely in your browser — your data never leaves your machine.
about.privacyText: We do not collect, store, or transmit any text you type or paste into our tools. Analytics are limited to anonymous page view counts (Google Analytics) so we can understand which tools are most useful. No personal data is ever processed.
about.openText: All tools are free to use, with no account required. If you find DevBox Tools useful, consider supporting the project.

privacy.metaDescription: DevBox Tools privacy policy. Learn what data we collect and how we protect your privacy.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: DevBox Tools is committed to protecting your privacy. This policy explains what information we collect and how we use it.
privacy.toolsText: All processing happens locally in your browser. Text, data, or files you enter into any tool are never sent to our servers. We have no access to your inputs.
privacy.analyticsText: We use Google Analytics to collect anonymous page view data (pages visited, session duration, country). This data does not include any text you enter into tools, and it does not identify you personally.
privacy.cookiesText: Google Analytics sets cookies to distinguish users and measure traffic. No other cookies are used by DevBox Tools.
privacy.contactText: If you have questions about this policy, please reach out via the contact page.

terms.metaDescription: Terms of use for DevBox Tools. Free developer utilities provided as-is.

terms.useText: DevBox Tools is provided free of charge for personal and professional use. You may use these tools in your development workflow, QA processes, and software testing.
terms.testingText: CPF and CNPJ numbers generated by this tool are fictitious. They are mathematically valid but do not correspond to any real person or company. Using these numbers for any purpose other than software testing is illegal.
terms.warrantyText: These tools are provided "as is" without warranty of any kind. We make no guarantees about accuracy or availability. Use at your own risk.
terms.changesText: We may update these terms at any time. Continued use of the site after changes constitutes acceptance of the new terms.

cnpjAlpha.metaTitle: Alphanumeric CNPJ — What Changed and How It Works
cnpjAlpha.metaDescription: Receita Federal issued the first alphanumeric CNPJ (00.000.000/E08G-12) on July 31, 2026. Learn the new algorithm, validation rules, and how to update your systems.
cnpjAlpha.title: Alphanumeric CNPJ
cnpjAlpha.subtitle: What changed on July 31, 2026 — and what your system needs to handle
cnpjAlpha.backgroundText: On July 31, 2026, the Receita Federal do Brasil issued the first alphanumeric CNPJ: 00.000.000/E08G-12. This change was made possible by Normativa RFB n. 2.243/2026, which extended the CNPJ format to include letters in the branch (filial) part of the number.
cnpjAlpha.whyText: The numeric CNPJ namespace was nearly exhausted. By introducing alphanumeric characters (A–Z) in positions 9–12 (the branch qualifier), the Receita Federal expanded the available space from roughly 10,000 to over 1.6 million branch codes per root.
cnpjAlpha.structureRootDesc: Always numeric. Identifies the legal entity.
cnpjAlpha.structureBranchDesc: Numeric for legacy CNPJs. May include letters A–Z for new CNPJs.
cnpjAlpha.structureCheckDesc: Always numeric. Calculated using the unified algorithm.
cnpjAlpha.algorithmText: The check digits use the same formula for both numeric and alphanumeric CNPJs. Each character is converted to a numeric value using charCode - 48:
cnpjAlpha.algorithmWeights: Weights for D1: [5,4,3,2,9,8,7,6,5,4,3,2] applied to positions 1–12. Weights for D2: [6,5,4,3,2,9,8,7,6,5,4,3,2] applied to positions 1–13 (including D1).
cnpjAlpha.algorithmRemainder: Result = remainder % 11. If remainder < 2, digit = 0. Otherwise digit = 11 - remainder.
cnpjAlpha.exampleText: The first alphanumeric CNPJ issued was 00.000.000/E08G-12. Verification:
cnpjAlpha.systemsTitle: What to Update in Your Systems
cnpjAlpha.systemsMask: Input masks: change from \d'{4}' to [0-9A-Z]'{4}' for branch positions.
cnpjAlpha.systemsRegex: Validation regex: accept letters in positions 9–12.
cnpjAlpha.systemsDb: Database columns: CNPJ fields must accept at least VARCHAR(18) to hold formatted values like 00.000.000/E08G-12.
cnpjAlpha.systemsCase: Case handling: treat letters case-insensitively. Normalize to uppercase before validation.
cnpjAlpha.toolText: Use the CPF/CNPJ tool to validate both numeric and alphanumeric CNPJs.
